activeRestrictions.summary: Production uses one VPS and one failure domain.
The public API remains limited to one replica while controls are process-local.
Review Vercel plan suitability before external onboarding or expanded commercial use.

followUps.summary: Differentiate Pipeline configuration conflict feedback from stale-revision feedback instead of grouping HTTP 409 and 412 into the same Web message.
Make surface-mode task validation provide the PostgreSQL DATABASE_* environment to database suites so explicit reruns are not required.

Align Web release tooling with Vercel Production-staged semantics: materialize the approved candidate with the Production environment and no canonical domain assignment before human promotion, then validate provenance and canonical content without assuming the deployment ID remains unchanged.
Resolve the pre-existing TypeScript TS2345 in src/server/api-proxy.ts by narrowing the validated lead contract value before passing it to buildUpstreamHeaders.
